resources.string: Lets Pinky on your computer read the controls on the screen and type text while an agent works on this phone. Pinky turns this service on over USB debugging only while an agent works here, and off again a few seconds after the task ends or you take over; it also turns itself off a minute after Pinky disconnects. Banking and other apps can see an accessibility service that is on. Turning it off here lasts until the next task; to keep Pinky from using it at all, uninstall Pinky Companion: Pinky works without it, only more slowly.
Pinky turns this service on through adb only while an agent works on this phone, and off again afterwards. Nothing here needs to be set up by hand.
Pinky\'s device tests write into these fields with set_text and read them back.
Posted by the Pinky Companion debug page.
Notifications are not allowed for this app.
